notes.title: 🎉 No Vacancy Tonight Launch Broadcast 🎉
notes.content:
[p]The motel doors are open! 👁️
Join us for this special launch broadcast of [i]No Vacancy Tonight[/i], a 3D mystery horror adventure where nothing is what it seems.[/p][p]Explore the abandoned motel, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth before it’s too late.[/p][p][/p][p]👻 Available on Steam September, 19[/p]

notes.title: 🕯️ No Vacancy Tonight launches this September – Book your room!
notes.content:
Get ready for the most haunting season of the year: No Vacancy Tonight opens its doors this September. We have prepared a new trailer!

[previewyoutube=31HYEc7Dd68;full][/previewyoutube]

Explore an allegedly deserted motel, solve first-person puzzles, and uncover a twisted story of cults, sin, and survival.

Inspired by psychological horror classics, this 3D narrative escape room will test both your mind and your nerves.

What begins as a cry for help spirals into a nightmare... and not everyone gets out.

🛎️ Hit “Add to Wishlist” and prepare to check into Steam’s most cursed motel.

There are no vacant rooms. Only secrets waiting to be unearthed.

notes.title: Let's play No Vacancy Tonight - Steam Scream Fest 🎃- DEMO UPDATED
notes.content:
Hello, horror and puzzle fans! 🖤 We’re excited to announce an updated demo for No Vacancy Tonight, our haunting adventure in the abandoned Motel 86, just in time for the Steam Scream Fest. Here’s what’s new:

🔹 Improved clue placement: We’ve relocated certain clues to help you navigate and keep the tension high without losing your way. Every riddle brings you closer to the mystery!

🔹 New Diner: Dive deeper into the era’s atmosphere! Our revamped Diner delivers an authentic, nostalgic experience combining horror and 60s vibes to enhance your exploration of the motel’s dark secrets.

🔹 Minor bug fixes: We’ve fine-tuned a few details for a smoother, uninterrupted experience.

The news doesn’t end here! We’re thrilled to be part of the Steam Scream Fest. Dive into our demo, solve puzzles, and don’t forget the lurking dangers that await.

Lastly, we’re setting an estimated release for early 2025. We’re dedicated to refining and enhancing the game to make it an unforgettable experience.

notes.content:
Imagine waking up trapped in an abandoned motel, at 3:30AM with the room's TV on. What is happening? Why is there no one there?

We'll play the first puzzles of No Vacancy Tonight.

You can try the demo now!
